technique_name: Explain how the Gini index is calculated.
description: The Gini index is a measure of economic inequality calculated by taking the ratio of the area between the Lorenz curve and the hypothetical line of perfect equality to the total area under the line of perfect equality. The Lorenz curve is a graph that plots the cumulative proportion of total income earned by the bottom x% of a population against the cumulative percentage of the population itself. It is calculated by first finding the cumulative percentage of income earned by consecutive segments
